candidates.demonstrated_gap: Fills the open gap: no installed skill has resolved rebase conflicts since resolving-merge-conflicts was retired (F3, #553). This skill resolves conflicts on its own, with no approval step. It starts from a compact summary of unmerged paths and index stages, then shows each file's ours/base/theirs hunks and a compact diff from a stdlib Python script (git subprocess only), and finally checks that no markers or unmerged paths remain. The trial must measure two gaps. (1) It advises taking one side wholesale with git checkout --ours/--theirs without noting that during a rebase 'ours' is the upstream, and it may hand-edit files, while docs/lanes.md forbids hand-merging manifests/evidence.json: take main's copy, re-register the branch's files, rerun the --write generators and scripts/validate.py. (2) Its commands hard-code python3 .agents/skills/resolve-merge-conflicts/scripts/... relative to the repo root, but this host installs skills at ~/.agents/skills with symlinks under ~/.claude/skills, so the literal path fails unless the agent rewrites it to the skill's base directory.
